title: Tampered evidence and assurance manifests
bad_event: A verifier accepts a manifest whose evidence log is not exactly a log independently anchored (modification, reordering, truncation or extension after anchoring).
adversary: Model: a writer that can append, rewrite the whole log and publish its own heads.
refutation: An accepted manifest that differs from every anchored log despite full checks (witnesses: no anchor/rollback, self-signed, unanchored suffix, hash collision).
scope: Lean model only. Entries are protected only once anchored (rewrite_before_anchor_window). Not: anchor-service compromise. The repo's own manifests are not yet anchored externally.

assumptions.text: An independently administered witness records heads (not the writer).
Chain head is injective on accepted/anchored logs (collision resistance).
Anchoring happens soon enough that the pre-anchor window is acceptable.
